text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hauu... I messed up again~~. And on top of 
that, I got injured...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
B-But... small injuries like this happen 
all the time, so I can get back to 
practice right away~.
choice_data_list: You should take a short break.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
If I rest, the gap between me and everyone 
else will just keep widening, won't it...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
"And yet, I'm sure I'll make another 
blunder... I-It feels like the gap will 
become completely unbridgeable!"

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wa-wa! P-Please let me go back to 
training after all!
choice_data_list: If it hurts, let's take a break.

If you can promise not to push yourself 
too hard—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Even if I say pain, it's honestly really 
mild...!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? C-Could it be... was that a trick 
question!?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Hau... I can't lie to you, Trainer. I'll 
take it easy and rest today~~...

Meisho Doto crawled into bed, quietly 
resting to recover.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Y-Yes! I'll wrap it in a bandage just in 
case!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
...Mm, huh...? This goes like this, and 
then...?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Fuehh!? T-The bandages got tangled around 
my legs!

Meisho Doto ended up aggravating her 
injuries, unable to return to training...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
T-Trainer-san, excuuuse me. Could you give 
me a hand with this?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
*yawn* It feels nice~ I-I barely feel any 
pain at all.

With the bandages securely wrapped, Meisho 
Doto was able to resume her training!
